SETTLEMENT PATTERN: Housing at the toe of the slope

Rainfall-triggered shallow slide.requires: prolonged or intense rainfall on a soil mantle
Rainfall-triggered shallow slide.provides: failure within hours of the rain, thin fast-moving debris, seasonal timing

Deep-seated rotational slump.provides: movement of centimetres per year with occasional acceleration, whole hillsides involved

Undercutting by a river.provides: progressive loss of support, failure at the toe first, predictable location

Slope loaded by construction fill.requires: material placed on an unstable slope
Slope loaded by construction fill.provides: an entirely human-made cause, failure soon after placement

Informal housing on the slope.provides: no engineering of any kind, cut-and-fill terracing by residents, very high exposure

Housing at the toe of the slope.provides: exposure to debris rather than to ground movement, no influence on the slope itself

Housing above the crest.provides: exposure to retrogressive failure, ground cracking as an early sign

Rainfall threshold exceedance.requires: a rain gauge network and a local threshold
Rainfall threshold exceedance.provides: hours of lead time, applicable only to rainfall-triggered failure

Ground movement instrumentation.provides: detection of slow movement, useless for a failure that begins suddenly

Visible tension cracking.requires: cracks large enough to be noticed
Visible tension cracking.provides: unambiguous but very late, minutes to days

No indicator at all.requires: no monitoring and no visible sign

Slope drainage works.requires: engineering access and a groundwater problem
Slope drainage works.provides: reduction of pore pressure, no effect on undercutting by water at the toe

Toe protection and revetment.provides: prevention of undercutting, no effect on rainfall infiltration

Managed relocation of residents.provides: complete removal of exposure, social and political cost

Early warning and evacuation.requires: a warning indicator and a rehearsed route
Early warning and evacuation.provides: lives saved, no protection of any property
